items.take: Franklin Electric reported Q3 2026 net sales of $633.6 million versus $581.7 million and diluted EPS of $1.35 versus $0.37. Net sales rose about 8.9% by our calculation, and 2026 guidance was raised.

items.take: International Paper reported Q3 2026 net sales of $6,197 million versus $6,222 million and a diluted net loss per share of $(2.13) versus $(2.09). Adjusted operating EPS (non-GAAP) was $0.37 versus $(0.43). Net sales fell about 0.4% by our calculation.

items.name: Hilton
items.take: Hilton reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $3,325 million versus $3,120 million, net income of $536 million versus $421 million, and diluted EPS of $2.37 versus $1.78. System-wide comparable RevPAR rose 5.8% on a currency-neutral basis. Revenue rose about 7% while GAAP EPS rose about 33% by our calculation.

items.name: Aon
items.take: Aon reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $4,101 million versus $3,997 million, with organic revenue growth of 6%, GAAP diluted EPS of $2.23 versus $2.11 and adjusted EPS of $3.36 versus $3.05. Operating income was $809 million versus $816 million. Total revenue rose about 2.6% by our calculation, below the 6% organic rate the company reports.

items.name: Lennox
items.take: Lennox reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,572.5 million versus $1,426.8 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $6.41 versus $7.38; adjusted EPS was $6.84 versus $7.38. The company lowered 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $21.00-$21.50 from $23.00-$24.00. Sales rose about 10% while GAAP EPS fell about 13% by our calculation.

items.name: Baker Hughes
items.take: Baker Hughes reported Q3 2026 revenue of $8,025 million versus $7,010 million, net income attributable to the company of $411 million versus $609 million, and diluted EPS of $0.41 versus $0.61. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.70 versus $0.68 and adjusted EBITDA was $1,415 million versus $1,238 million; the release attributes the year-over-year revenue increase mainly to the Chart acquisition. Revenue rose about 14% while GAAP EPS fell about 33% by our calculation, so adjusted and GAAP results moved in opposite directions.

items.name: WM
items.take: WM reported Q3 2026 revenue of $6,846 million versus $6,443 million, net income attributable to WM of $820 million versus $603 million, and diluted EPS of $2.05 versus $1.49. Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.15 versus $1.98, and free cash flow was $985 million versus $821 million; the release says 2025 figures were updated for a reclassification of landfill accretion expense. Revenue grew about 6% and GAAP EPS about 38% by our calculation.

items.name: Arch Capital Group
items.take: Arch Capital Group reported Q3 2026 net income available to common shareholders of $1,025 million, or $3.00 per diluted share, versus $1,340 million, or $3.56, a year earlier. After-tax operating income was $2.67 per diluted share versus $2.77. Net income was down about 23% and diluted EPS about 16% by our calculation.

items.name: PPG Industries
items.take: PPG reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4,353 million versus $4,082 million a year earlier (up about 7% by our calculation). Net income attributable to PPG was $451 million versus $453 million, with diluted EPS of $2.02 versus $2.00; adjusted EPS was $2.25 versus $2.13. Income from continuing operations rose to $473 million from $444 million, so the discontinued-operations line explains the gap to total net income.

items.name: Mirion Technologies
items.take: Mirion Technologies reported Q3 2026 revenue of $277.8 million versus $223.1 million a year earlier (up 24.5%), GAAP net income of $7.8 million versus $3.1 million, and GAAP EPS of $0.03 versus $0.01. Adjusted EPS was $0.12, unchanged from a year ago. Orders excluding Paragon and July Certrec results were $340 million versus $209 million, up 62%.

items.name: LPL Financial
items.take: LPL Financial reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $5,344.0 million versus $4,552.0 million a year earlier (up 17% by our calculation), net income of $357 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $4.52 versus a loss of $0.37 in Q3 2025. Adjusted EPS rose 15% to $5.97 from $5.20. The year-ago quarter carried $538 million of acquisition costs versus $83 million this quarter, which flatters the GAAP comparison.

items.name: Expand Energy
items.take: Expand Energy reported Q3 2026 total revenues and other of $3,286 million versus $2,966 million, net income of $519 million versus $547 million, and diluted EPS of $2.24 versus $2.28. Adjusted net income was $338 million versus $234 million, and net production was 7.54 Bcfe/d versus 7.33 Bcfe/d, 92% natural gas. Higher volumes and a wider non-GAAP profit contrasted with slightly lower GAAP earnings.

items.name: Caesars Entertainment
items.take: Caesars Entertainment reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $2,940 million versus $2,869 million, a net loss attributable to Caesars of $123 million versus $55 million, and a diluted loss per share of $0.61 versus $0.27. Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA was $865 million versus $884 million; segment net revenues were $930 million in Las Vegas versus $952 million and $1,627 million in Regional versus $1,536 million. Revenue edged up while the loss widened.
items.source_name: Caesars Entertainment Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.name: NXP Semiconductors
items.take: NXP reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3,786 million versus $3,173 million a year earlier (up 19% by our calculation), with GAAP diluted EPS of $3.48 versus $2.48 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.20 versus $3.11. Revenue and per-share earnings both rose by double digits, a broad gain in the chipmaker's results.

items.name: CoStar Group
items.take: CoStar reported Q3 2026 revenue of $952 million versus $834 million a year earlier (up 14% by our calculation), net income of $74 million versus a $31 million loss, and diluted EPS of $0.18 versus $(0.07). Adjusted EBITDA was $229 million versus $114 million. Earnings swung to a profit on revenue growth, a sharp improvement in profitability.

items.name: Robinhood Markets
items.take: Robinhood reported Q3 2026 total net revenues of $1,424 million versus $1,274 million a year earlier (up 12% by our calculation), net income of $476 million versus $556 million, and diluted EPS of $0.51 versus $0.61. Funded Customers reached 28.7 million and Total Platform Assets $396 billion.

items.name: Coca-Cola Co
items.take: Coca-Cola reported Q3 2026 net operating revenues of $13,380 million versus $12,455 million a year earlier, up 7%, with organic revenue growth of 7% and unit case volume up 5%. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.93 versus $0.86, and comparable EPS was $0.91, up 11%. Volume and pricing both appear to be supporting the top line, though the release leads with organic growth.

items.name: IQVIA Holdings
items.take: IQVIA reported Q3 2026 revenue of $4,428 million versus $4,100 million, up 8.0%, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.10 versus $1.93 and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.34 versus $3.00. Net new bookings were $3.2 billion, a 1.2x book-to-bill, and full-year 2026 guidance is now revenue of $17,350 million to $17,500 million and adjusted EPS of $12.90 to $13.00. R&DS contracted backlog stood at $32.6 billion after an approximately $2.1 billion adjustment for inactive trials, a reminder that bookings strength and backlog quality are separate questions.

items.name: SoFi Technologies
items.take: SoFi reported Q3 2026 total net revenue of $1,385.1 million versus $961.6 million a year earlier, up 44%, with GAAP net income of $241.0 million versus $139.4 million and diluted EPS of $0.18 versus $0.11. Members reached 17.1 million versus 12.6 million, and products reached nearly 26.7 million versus 18.6 million. Member and product growth ran at 35% and 44%, respectively.

items.name: Novartis AG
items.take: Novartis reported Q3 2026 net sales of $14,522 million versus $13,909 million, up 4% in both USD and constant currencies, and core operating income of $6,036 million, up 11%. Core EPS was $2.46 versus $2.25, while IFRS net income was $1,196 million versus $3,930 million and EPS $0.63 versus $2.04. Full-year core operating income is now expected to be in line to grow low single digit in constant currencies, versus a low single-digit decline previously; the gap between IFRS and core results is large this quarter and worth reading in the release's reconciliation.

items.name: Royal Caribbean Group
